title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the work done by the electric force.

title: Electric Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the electric field in the region between the spheres.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the electric field energy before and after the contraction.

title: Energy Change Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should express the work done as the change in electric field energy.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating the work done.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as constants, are included in the final answer.
